relevant_facts: --write-fills streams fills in API fills format to node_fills/hourly/{date}/{hour}
--batch-by-block writes one block per line with local_time, block_time, block_number and events
node output can therefore provide population-wide fill history without first querying individual wallet addresses
node_fills_by_block contains fills streamed via --write-fills --batch-by-block
older node_fills is a different format and matches the API fill format
requesters pay transfer costs for S3 historical data
userFills is per address and returns at most 2000 recent fills
userFillsByTime is per address, returns at most 2000 fills per response and only the 10000 most recent fills are available
documented fill objects include closedPnl, coin, crossed, dir, hash, oid, px, side, startPosition, sz, time, fee, feeToken and tid
portfolio returns accountValueHistory, pnlHistory and volume across several horizons
userRole can distinguish User, Agent, Vault, Subaccount and Missing
REST requests share an aggregated 1200 weight per minute IP limit
most documented info requests have weight 20
clearinghouseState has weight 2
userRole has weight 60
userFills and userFillsByTime have additional weight based on returned items
the documentation recommends S3 for large batch historical requests
portfolio graphs expose account value and PnL histories
account value includes unrealized PnL and vault balances
PnL adjusts account value for deposits and withdrawals
graphs are sampled and are not recommended for precise accounting
entry price, unrealized PnL and closed PnL are frontend convenience components
fundamental accounting is based on margin or spot balance and trades
for perps, closed PnL includes the fee plus position PnL on closing trades and only the fee on opening trades
px means price and sz means size in units of coin
notional is price times size
side B means bid/buy and A means ask/short
side is the aggressing side for trades
the frontend max-drawdown metric is a convenience metric
users may compute their own metric from account-value and PnL histories

inferences_explicitly_not_direct_source_: population-wide archive scanning before per-wallet API enrichment is the preferred project architecture
closedPnl is useful for candidate screening but insufficient by itself for exact account return
portfolio and role queries should be reserved for a reduced shortlist to control rate-limit cost
the modern node_fills_by_block address key should be empirically bridged before broader historical ingestion
